Select IC50 activities in nM for compounds tested against human TYK2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
